purpose: 8DNA same-state refit control for the worklog-21 teaset trajectory. Written before any refit training output exists.

T0_retrain.role: pipeline control: same code, schedule and seed as the T3 refit, on the canonical state

T3_refit.role: same-state refit: persistent state rebuilt on T3

training.config: upstream configs/default.yaml unchanged: bounce 2, dataset N=128 H=128 SPP=256 batch 32768, dataset_reload 1, lr 5e-4, gradient_clip_val 5, val_spp 128, model block identical to the released teaset checkpoint
training.checkpoint_used: last.ckpt (end of schedule; no selection on validation loss)

evaluation.regime: worklog-21 envmap regime: res 512, reference prb 2x2048 spp with the locked seeds, neural 512 spp seed 0, upstream neuralpath

renders.T0_retrain_at_T0: retrained checkpoint, upstream mode, T0 scene
renders.T3_refit_at_T3: refit checkpoint, upstream mode, T3 scene (its canonical frame is T3, so no pullback)

evaluation.compare_with: worklog-21 frozen released attached renders at T0 and T3

decision_rule.pipeline_control: T0_retrain is a usable control if its T0 interaction-ROI display-MAE error is within 25% of the released checkpoint's T0 error; otherwise the refit is judged only against T0_retrain and the discrepancy is reported
decision_rule.refit_recovers: T3_refit interaction-ROI error at T3 is at most 1.25x T0_retrain's error on the same surfaces at T0, AND the tracking gain <N_refit(T3) - N_retrain(T0), dG>/<dG,dG> is at least 0.5
decision_rule.cases: A: frozen fails and refit recovers (stale persistent state supported, capacity sufficient); B: frozen fails and refit does not recover (capacity/optimization remains plausible)
